competitor_evidence_is_lead_only: Every row here is an IDENTITY LEAD. A competitor's petsAllowed flag is a TARGETING HINT that decides read ORDER and nothing else. a_directory_url_is_never_a_route: A bringfido.com/lodging/<id> URL is a lead's address at the COMPETITOR. It is not the property's official URL and is never routed or captured as one.
